Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: settlement being founded
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has begun building a new settlement at the edge of its territory (Faction Territories expansion). The site can be attacked until it is finished.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} builds a new settlement near {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: new settlement founded
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction has finished building a new settlement (Faction Territories expansion).
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} founds {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: construction site attacked
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction's settlement construction site has been attacked (Faction Territories expansion). The builders hold a grievance, and it counts in any war between the two.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} attacks settlers of {1} near {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: trade convoy lost
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A RimMarket trade convoy has been destroyed on its way to your colony. Its faction holds a grievance against the attackers, if they are known.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Trade convoy of {0} from {2} destroyed by {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: starvation
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction cannot feed and supply its people from its stores (Economics & Demography upkeep shortfall). People are dying, stability and legitimacy fall each day it lasts, and relief aid is welcome.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: Hunger in {0}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: stores plundered
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: Raiders have carried off part of a faction's stores (Economics & Demography). The losses hurt its economy for a few days.
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} raids the stores of {1}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: new settlement
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A growing faction has spent part of its wealth on a new settlement (Economics & Demography expansion).
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} founds {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: wanderers settle
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A faction that had lost all its settlements has gathered enough people to settle again (Economics & Demography).
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} settles again at {2}

Dominion.DominionEventDef.label: settlement abandoned
Dominion.DominionEventDef.description: A shrinking faction could no longer keep one of its settlements going and has left it in ruins (Economics & Demography).
Dominion.DominionEventDef.headline: {0} abandons {2}
